summary: Round 2 covers only commit 202c194 ('review fixes r1'). It changes 2 test files, adds 22 lines, removes none, and leaves src/ untouched, so no assertion was removed or weakened. All five round-1 MAJORs are fixed. I re-ran each mutant in a scratch copy outside the repo, running tests/table/ and tests/ui/ (13 files, 48 tests). Each mutant now fails 1 test, and the unmutated baseline passes 48/48. (1) Ignoring the button in positionName (`const order = [...seats]`) is caught by the new 6-max table of buttons 1-5 and the 3-handed button-1 case. (2) Raise text using `added` is caught by the new `{...record('raise', 8), added: 4}` -> 'Raised to $8' check. (3) `.at(0)` instead of `.at(-1)` is caught by the new assertion that seat 1 shows 'Called $2'. (4) Dropping the showdown->river mapping is caught by the new SHOWDOWN assertions: seats 2 and 5 'Checked', seat 6 'Folded'. (5) `streetAmount >= 0` in Table.tsx is caught by the new checks in table-display.acceptance that the street line is absent. The new assertions are correct for the spec: button 6 is already covered by the existing case, and the rotation rows match the spec's position names. The gate fix-2 passes (tests, lint, typecheck, test integrity). No Vitest run was active when I ran the mutants. I deleted the scratch copy afterwards, and the repo working tree is clean apart from the reviews/round-2 folder.
